title: Testing (Scenario): `check_cloudspec_consistency` can be removed
body: In [check_cloudspec_consistency](https://github.com/canonical/operator/blob/main/testing/src/scenario/_consistency_checker.py#L722), Scenario complains if the cloud spec's type is set to `kubernetes`. This is no longer relevant as the cloud spec type is now also reported on `kubernetes` models.
author: reneradoi
